summary: Luzerne County miner killed at the Boston colliery in 1909, son of Edmund Grimes and Catherine Heffernan; John's 2nd cousin 4 times removed.
bio: Richard E. Grimes was born about 1858, a son of Edmund Grimes and Catherine Heffernan. He was killed in a mine accident at the Boston D&H colliery in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, in 1909. His brother Edmund D. Grimes also died in a mine accident, in California in 1927. Richard is John's 2nd cousin 4 times removed.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
